## 🚨 [Ops] Error Handler → Slack

**Reusable error notifier for your whole n8n instance.**

Whenever a workflow that points to this one fails, n8n triggers it
automatically and posts the failure details to Slack:
workflow name, the node that failed, the error message, and a link
to the failed execution.

### How to attach it to a workflow
Open any workflow → **Settings (3 dots) → Settings → Error Workflow**
→ select **[Ops] Error Handler → Slack**.

### Setup
- Pick your Slack credential + alert channel on the **Send Slack Alert** node.
- That's it — no trigger to run manually; it fires on failures.

nodes.name: On Error
nodes.notes: Fires automatically when any workflow that has this set as its Error Workflow fails. Receives the failed execution + error details.

nodes.name: Format Error Message
nodes.notes: Turns the raw error payload into a readable Slack message.

nodes.name: Send Slack Alert
nodes.notes: Sends the failure alert to Slack.
